svg.text: Study007 / frozen-model measured evidence
627 canonical /4520 raw boards; host integer counterfactuals, not new target benchmarks or model-heldout tests.
A / post-route output-vector scope: candidate expert3, control expert0
Recipient readout residual + recipient router/gates + selected expert outputs -> rounded mixture -> frozen output head. Only declared expert output
vectors are transplanted/zeroed. Other learned computation remains.
Natural contrasts: one legal mark relocation, same raw candidate/ply/geometry/fold; candidate active both; gate difference <=4096/32768. Route-fixed and
naturally route-changing contrasts are separate.
